name: Instant Atta Noodles with Seasoning
ingredients_raw: NOODLES (85%): Wheat Flour (Atta), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), lodised Salt, Acidity Regulators [INS 451(i) & INS 500(i)], Antioxidant (INS 319) & Thickener (INS 412). SEASONING MIX (15%): Dehydrated Vegetab Green Peas & Carrot), Sugar, Wheat Flour (Atta), lodise 8.15% (Turmeric, Red Chilli, Fenugreek, Coriander, Cumin, Fe Black Pepper, Ginger, Green Cardamom, Clove, Nutmeg, Asafoetica Onion Powder, Corn Starch, Yeast Extract Powder, Hydrolysed Vegetable (Soya), Flavour Enhancers (INS 631 & INS 62, Cumin Seed Bits, Deh Fenugreek Leaves, Garlic Powder, Flavours (Natural & Nature Identical Flakes, Colours [INS 100(ii) & INS 160c(1) Dehydrated Green Coriander Acidity Regulator (INS 330). ALLERGEN INFORMATION; CONTAINS WHEAT & SOY MAY CONTAIN MILK.
